deviations_from_card: One commit instead of three. Validation reuses the demo kit's argumentErrors (door.ts as 59287f5 left it) with one allowance: an unnamed argument is refused only when the schema is closed (additionalProperties:false), production's check_schema rule, so shell hands (open schemas) are not refused for keys the daemon would pass; kit pages and the connector fakes are closed, so for them it is the kit verdict exactly. The kit validator does not know JSON Schema 'integer' or maxLength; no kit page or hand publishes integer today. Connector writes are fenced uncapped (production caps and fences reads only). ADR 0153 added. approvals.ts change is small (consumedAt + two reasons) so slot B can serialise consumedAt.
notes: The gate spec runs offline under the Playwright runner with no page fixture (0.5 s); the full journey (four booted servers) was NOT run - the card's by-hand gate remains for the coordinator/operator: confirm no beat in journey.spec.ts / take.spec.ts re-cites a card or passes an extra connector key (grep says none). Page-tier calls now validate against the page's published schema before the card is spent, so a page validator_failed now lands before consumption rather than after. Surface.refused/ConnectorSurface.refused report only gate-stage refusals (transport failures still throw, as before). withRow removed from surface.ts (no other user). No sibling reds seen.
